Although these adjacencies contribute only 10-12% to revenue, they are growing at a much faster rate sequentially, given the significant after-market support and fleet management required vs. the one-time sell for PVs.
Secondly, these adjacencies fall beyond the ambit of Chinese competitions (concentrated on PV), thus providing TELX an opportunity to recoup some of the revenue leakages from the European PV market.
The European market remains under pressure due to a weak revenue profile for both classic and luxury OEMs, resulting in execution delays and program deferrals on new PV launches.
